Alex: Quick sync — Q3 adaptive caching rollout needs a staging window and canary plan. Product wants a customer pilot starting 2026-06-07. Who owns capacity sizing?
Maria: I can drive sizing with runtime, but need infra + security constraints. Estimated peak for pilot ~3k QPS, baseline 600 QPS. :eyes:
Kevin: Runtime: for 3k QPS we need ~6 inference pods with continuous batching enabled, maybe 8 for headroom. Need node types (A100 vs H100) from infra.
Sam: Infra: we can carve a Dedicated pool for the pilot. H100 capacity is tight in us-west2 in that window. Asking for lead time — 4 weeks to reserve and provision.
Jen: Security: customer requires KMS-managed keys + audit logs to be enabled, and no model weights leaving VPC. Private control-plane option?
Alex: Product constraint: pilot must use private endpoints + KMS. If we can't do private by pilot start, they will delay.
Maria: Tradeoff idea — start pilot on Dedicated with VPC peering, enable KMS later as a gated feature. Is that acceptable?
Jen: Can't enable pilot without KMS at minimum. Audit logging can be rolled afterwards but key ownership is mandatory.
Kevin: If KMS is required from day 1, runtime needs permission tokens injected via our secret delivery flow. That adds ~3 days dev time.
Sam: Infrastructure tasks: reserve nodes, network peering, load balancer, and VPN routing if needed. I'll need an exact CIDR list and expected egress.
Alex: I'll get CIDR + expected egress by EOD. Also we need canary rollout cadence: product wants 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% over 3 days with rollback gates.
Maria: Runtime OK with that cadence if autoscale thresholds are tuned. We should set token-level throttles and a canary prompt set for quality checks.
Kevin: Add a staged kernel/quant config change: canary uses quant profile A, full rollout uses A with cache enabled globally. Need to validate outputs vs baseline for 5k prompts.
Jen: Security will run a quick threat review once we have network design. Also need an SLA annex for the pilot customers.
Sam: Ops note: during canary we'll need elevated monitoring retention for traces (48h) and an on-call rotation. Requesting a temporary SRE pager.
Alex: Who volunteers to be on-call for the pilot week? @Kevin?
Kevin: I can take the lead on runtime on-call that week.
Maria: I'll own the rollout plan doc and coord QA for the prompt set.
Jen: I'll run threat review and KMS setup.
Sam: I'll file infra tickets and start node reservation, tagging them with the pilot code: pilot/ACacheQ3.
deploy-bot: Deployment window created: 2026-06-01T22:00Z -> 2026-06-03T04:00Z. Tickets: INF-4821, RTE-7712.
Alex: Thanks. Action items: Maria (sizing + rollout doc), Sam (node reservation + network), Jen (KMS + threat review), Kevin (runtime on-call + canary validation). I'll check back 48h after initial drafts. :thumbsup:
